gfz_kp.role: quiet and moderate daily activity selection

ipshocks.role: isolated L1 shock/sheath selection and event exclusion

richardson_cane.role: ICME exclusion and complex interacting-ejecta selection

global_rules.entire_2024_exclusion_reason: V1 inspected Gannon, fixed controls, OMNI controls, and donor-offset windows during 2024; excluding the full year prevents accidental reuse

mission_eras.availability_warning: actual product availability is tested only after the registry is frozen; missing ACE or another mission becomes INCOMPLETE_MULTIPOINT or ERA_ACE_UNAVAILABLE

QUIET_SOLAR_WIND.eligibility: daily maximum Kp <= 2.0 and no IPShocks cluster or Richardson-Cane disturbance/ICME start within 24 hours of the UTC day
QUIET_SOLAR_WIND.ranking: within each era sort by Kp mean ascending, Kp maximum ascending, then UTC date ascending
QUIET_SOLAR_WIND.warning: Kp-quiet is not equivalent to L1-featureless

MODERATE_VARIABILITY.eligibility: 3.0 <= daily maximum Kp <= 4.0 and no IPShocks cluster or Richardson-Cane disturbance/ICME start within 24 hours of the UTC day
MODERATE_VARIABILITY.ranking: within each era sort by absolute(Kp mean - 1.75), Kp maximum ascending, then UTC date ascending

ISOLATED_SHOCK_OR_SHEATH.eligibility: IPShocks fast-forward L1 shock cluster with at least one named ACE, Wind, or DSCOVR detection and at least 72 hours to the nearest other L1 shock cluster and Richardson-Cane disturbance
ISOLATED_SHOCK_OR_SHEATH.clustering: catalog rows separated by no more than 90 minutes are one shock cluster
ISOLATED_SHOCK_OR_SHEATH.ranking: within each era sort by nearest-event separation descending, number of named spacecraft descending, then reference time ascending
ISOLATED_SHOCK_OR_SHEATH.interval: 24 hours centered on the median catalog shock time
ISOLATED_SHOCK_OR_SHEATH.warning: catalog-isolated is not equivalent to structure-free

COMPLEX_INTERACTING_EJECTA.eligibility: Richardson-Cane cluster containing at least two disturbance/ICME entries within 48 hours or a catalog row linked to at least two distinct LASCO CME times
COMPLEX_INTERACTING_EJECTA.clustering: successive Richardson-Cane disturbance times no more than 48 hours apart form one candidate complex cluster
COMPLEX_INTERACTING_EJECTA.ranking: within each era sort by catalog entry count descending, linked CME count descending, then first disturbance ascending
COMPLEX_INTERACTING_EJECTA.interval: 36 hours beginning six hours before the first catalog disturbance
COMPLEX_INTERACTING_EJECTA.warning: catalog complexity identifies an event class; it does not prove every internal boundary is one structure
